Supreme Court questions Election Commission on Delhi electoral roll discrepancies

The Supreme Court has asked the Election Commission of India (ECI) to explain logical discrepancies in the Special Summary Revision (SIR) notices issued in Delhi. The court issued a notice to the ECI in response to a petition filed by Anjali Bhardwaj and Amrita Johri. The petition challenges the deletion of lakhs of names from the electoral roll in Delhi during the SIR exercise. The court flagged "mechanical notices" related to the discrepancies.
